APIV1Service.SignIn — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go
APIV1Service.fetchCurrentUser — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go
APIV1Service.resolveSSOUser — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go
APIV1Service.getLinkedSSOUser — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go
APIV1Service.GetInstanceAdmin — server/router/api/v1/instance_service.go

FileServerService.getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go
RSSService.GetUserRSS — server/router/rss/rss.go

Tests also call it and would need updating: `store/test/user_test.go`, `store/test/user_delete_test.go`, `store/demo_seed_test.go`, and in `server/router/api/v1/test/`: `user_resource_name_test.go`, `user_email_visibility_test.go`, `user_service_delete_test.go`, `user_service_email_username_test.go`.

Two look-alikes that are *not* affected. `store/db/mysql/user.go` line 77 calls `d.GetUser`, which is the MySQL driver's own method (the driver-level `GetUser` is a separate declaration from the `Store` wrapper), and `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` line 115 calls `APIV1Service.GetUser`, the RPC handler. Both share the name but are distinct methods.

Practical note: `fetchCurrentUser` and `resolveBearer` are on the hot path for essentially every authenticated request, so a signature change there has the widest blast radius even though it's only two call sites.
